coverage.authorization_and_replay: unauthorized, expired, stale, replayed, duplicate, out-of-order, backoff, epoch, nonce, ticket, and sequence-exhaustion paths reject before mutation
coverage.capacity_and_reserve: ticket, replay, terminal, audit, application, administration, recovery, ISR, and exclusive-resource saturation preserve HP1's fixed administration and recovery reserves
coverage.journal_and_boot: every erase, record-body, and commit-marker prefix for both candidate records preserves a deterministic last-confirmed or no-viable authority
coverage.quiesce_and_unload: guest/refinement refusal, timeout, trap, failure, and reordered evidence cannot enter update or consume the exclusive reserve
coverage.recovery: automatic no-viable and administrative recovery interactions preserve host-only control, explicit abort/status, and HP3-owned reboot selection
coverage.stream_and_verification: every safe artifact byte-prefix cut plus malformed shape, wrong transaction, timeout, rate, abort race, artifact, bundle, compatibility, security-floor, authority, and verifier rejects fail closed

external ESP32 provider or Pulse-core change

finding.mutation_rule: no ticket allocation, replay high-water advance, mode change, control-lane admission, terminal, audit, or slot mutation
finding.name: COMMAND_SEQUENCE_EXHAUSTION_REJECTED_PREACCEPT
finding.recovery: the exhausted session remains closable; a strictly newer authenticated epoch starts a fresh session at sequence one

invariants.accepted_terminal: every accepted command produces exactly one retained first-terminal-wins completion
invariants.application_pressure: application work cannot consume the administration or safety-recovery lanes or prevent status, abort, or recovery control
invariants.boot_authority: HP3 remains the sole durable slot, last-confirmed, trial, fallback, and reboot-selection authority
invariants.journal_failure: no interrupted candidate record becomes authoritative and the last confirmed record is preserved whenever one exists
invariants.preaccept: every rejection occurs before a ticket, replay advance, mode transition, control enqueue, audit record, terminal record, or slot mutation
invariants.private_surface: administration remains absent from the guest ABI and native-extension SDK
invariants.resource_authority: HP1 scheduling, fixed memory, exclusive admission, and reserved control lanes are unchanged
invariants.stream_failure: every failure before durable trial handoff aborts staging and returns to NORMAL or RECOVERY according to transaction origin

matrix.journal_formula: 2 target records * ((256 + 1) erase prefixes + (252 + 1) record-body prefixes + (4 + 1) commit-marker prefixes) = 1030
matrix.safe_stream_formula: complete stored artifact bytes 2361 + empty prefix = 2362
